correctness.rationale: In the ten matrix-unit basis, B_lambda(X,Y)=lambda(XY-YX) is alternating for every characteristic. An independent SymPy construction of all 45 principal 8x8 minors found 24 nonzero Pfaffians with exactly six distinct factors up to sign: (be-cd)c^2, (be-cd)ac, (be-cd)bc, (be-cd)ce, (be-cd)cf and (be-cd)(ae+bf), each repeated four times. Explicit lower Pfaffian witnesses and the disjoint cases c!=0, c=0/be!=0, c=e=0/b!=0, c=b=0/e!=0, and b=c=e=0 give exactly the five stated rank-count polynomials summing to q^6. Independent matrix-unit rank computations over prime fields q=2,3,5 reproduce every stratum. For each additive functional, the bilinear character sum over (X,Y) equals q^(20-rank), so F_q(h)=q^14 sum q^(-rank)psi(-ch). Weighted c=0 versus c!=0 strata give the displayed F(0), F(h!=0), and difference q^11(q^2+q-1). This is additive algebra commutator, not group multiplicative commutator, and characteristic two is included by Pfaffian polynomial identity. A separate integer Fourier calculation using independently enumerated prime-field Kirillov ranks also reproduced F_q(0), F_q(h!=0) and their difference for q=2,3,5.
